title: DNA Extraction and Purification from Soil
author: Justin GD Byrne

steps.title: Prepare tube with beads
steps.instruction: Add 2 g of acid‑washed garnet beads (1.0 mm to 1.4 mm diameter) to a 5 mL Eppendorf screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Add first lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 2200 µL of Lysis Solution 1 to the tube and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add soil sample
steps.instruction: Add 0.25 g of soil sample, then shake briefly by hand to mix.

steps.title: Grind sample in Geno/Grinder
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a Geno/Grinder 2010 (Pulverizer and Cell Lyser, SPEX CertiPrep™, catalog 12605297) with appropriate adapters and grind at 1750 RPM for 2 min, then repeat for an additional 2 min.

steps.title: Add second lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of Lysis Solution 2 to the tube.

steps.title: First centrifugation and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C (room temperature). Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube (or transfer 1 mL and retain 500 µL as indicated).

steps.title: Second centrifugation and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C. Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Protein flocculant treatment
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Protein flocculant, vortex briefly, and incubate on ice for a minimum of 10 min.

steps.title: Protein flocculant centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C and transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Prepare inhibitor master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine 110 µL of Inhibitor flocculant 1 with 110 µL of Inhibitor flocculant 2 (n × 110 µL of each, where n = number of samples) to make the inhibitor flocculant master mix.

steps.title: Add inhibitor flocculant
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the inhibitor flocculant master mix to each sample.

steps.title: Inhibitor centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C and transfer the supernatant to a fresh 5 mL tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Add 1568 µL of Binding Solution and invert several times to mix. Load the mixture onto an EZ‑10 Spin Column & Collection Tube (Consumables, Bio Basic, SD5005.SIZE.100, https://www.nbsbio.co.uk/sd5005-size-100?gclid=Cj0KCQiA8vSOBhCkARIsAGdp6RQgyYUlHdo2N2nnE1nR6AKaPfWG2y0hACxzvQLo6I056CWZgWnDzbcaAsKdEALw_wcB) to capacity, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C, discard flow‑through, and repeat until all liquid has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 392 µL of Wash Solution, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C, discard flow‑through, then centrifuge again at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C with a fresh 1.5 mL collection tube to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 313 µL of Elution Buffer pre‑heated to 70 °C directly onto the silica membrane, let stand for 2 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at 25 °C. The purified DNA is now in the collection tube.

steps.title: Remove liquid from lids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube at 1000 × g for 30 s at 25 °C to remove liquid from the tube lids.

steps.title: Seal tubes
steps.instruction: Parafilm the lids of the tubes to prevent leaks.

steps.title: Alternative 96‑well plate protocol (optional)
steps.instruction: For high‑throughput processing, use a 96‑well silica plate (Bio Basic, SD5007.SIZE.12, 960 µL per well; https://www.nbsbio.co.uk/sd5007-size-12) with a breathable film (StarLab, E2796‑3005; https://www.starlabgroup.com/GB-en/product/breathable-film-e2796-3005.html). Fill each well with 600 µL of the binding mixture, seal with the film, and centrifuge at 4000 × g for 5 min over a 2.2 mL deep‑well plate to collect the flow‑through. Repeat the fill‑seal‑centrifuge cycle until all mixture has passed, replacing the breathable film each time.
